## Oyster Reef {#am_oyster}

All of the oyster habitat mixed models treated the reefs sampled as a
random effect to account for the fact that they usually represented only
a small subset of the many reefs that could have been chosen within a
managed area in any given year. These time series analyses were also
only conducted for managed areas that had five or more years of data for
a given oyster habitat indicator.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

***Percent Live Analysis***

Trends in oyster percent live were analyzed using a logistic regression
model to test for changes across the time series. The logistic
regression slopes were exponentiated to convert them into estimates of
the yearly change in proportion of live oysters.

***Density Analysis***

Change in oyster density over time was analyzed with a negative binomial
regression model of oyster density over the years in the time series.
The regression slopes were transformed using the exponential function to
provide annual estimates of changes in density in the original units.

***Shell Height Analysis***

Change in oyster size over time was analyzed for two different classes
of shell heights: 25-75mm and ≥75mm. Each size class time series was
tested for trends using generalized LME models of shell height by year.
For several managed areas additional historical information on oyster
size for a small number of reefs was available from radiocarbon-dated
samples of dead shells. When available, those data are reported, but
they were analyzed separately from the live oyster shell measurements
because of differences in the geographic scope and temporal resolution.
